newsitem.title: USA: American readies plans for Miami terminal.
newsitem.headline: American readies plans for Miami terminal.

text.p: American Airlines of AMR Corp said Tuesday it was ready to go ahead with plans to build a new 47-gate hub terminal at Miami International Airport.
It said it had chosen a program manager and 15 contractors for the design and development phase of the $975 million project, known as the A/D Concourse.

The project is part of a $4 billion, 10-year expansion plan of the airport. American said the project will eventually require more contractors, creating more than 4,000 jobs at the peak of construction.
Last month, a U.S. federal ruling found the rate structure that American wanted to apply to other airlines was fair, despite protests by six airlines.
More than 92 passenger airlines will be obliged to share the cost of building the terminal.
